name: 中心辐射图

prompt_template.subject: {central_topic}
prompt_template.layout: central hub with radial spokes to peripheral nodes
prompt_template.style: clean radial diagram with central hub and organized peripheral branches
prompt_template.color_scheme: central hub in primary color, each spoke branch in distinct hue
prompt_template.labels: central topic in large bold, branch topics in semibold, sub-topics in regular

clean.description: 简洁辐射风格，线条清晰

overrides.style: minimal radial diagram with thin lines and clean nodes

mindmap.description: 思维导图风格，分支展开

overrides.style: mind map with curved organic branches and varying node sizes
infographic with icon-based nodes and colored connection lines

overrides.layout: concentric circles with central core, inner ring, outer ring

category_tips.biology: 中心概念为系统/过程；分支为组件/阶段；用图标表示生物实体
category_tips.medicine: 中心为疾病/治疗；分支为病因/症状/诊断/治疗；用色块表示严重度
category_tips.chemistry: 中心为元素/反应；分支为性质/应用/化合物；用结构式图标
category_tips.physics: 中心为定律/概念；分支为公式/应用/实验；用矢量图标
category_tips.engineering: 中心为系统/产品；分支为模块/功能/接口；用流程图标
category_tips.math: 中心为定理/概念；分支为推论/应用/证明；用公式图标

examples: Hub-and-spoke knowledge diagram of the cell, central hub: 细胞 (Cell) in large bold. 6 radial spokes to: (1) Nucleus 细胞核 with icon, (2) Mitochondria 线粒体, (3) ER 内质网, (4) Golgi 高尔基体, (5) Membrane 细胞膜, (6) Ribosome 核糖体. Central hub purple #8b5cf6, each spoke distinct hue. Branch topics semibold, sub-topics regular. 4K, clean radial diagram.

Mind map of machine learning, central node: Machine Learning. 4 curved organic branches: Supervised Learning (blue), Unsupervised Learning (green), Reinforcement Learning (orange), Deep Learning (purple). Each branch with sub-nodes: Supervised -> Classification, Regression; Unsupervised -> Clustering, PCA; etc. Varying node sizes by importance. 4K.

Concentric circles diagram of ecological hierarchy, central core: Organism 个体. Inner ring: Population 种群, Community 群落. Outer ring: Ecosystem 生态系统, Biosphere 生物圈. Each ring distinct color. Labels bilingual. 4K, education style.
accuracy_tips: 中心概念与分支层级关系准确；分支属于同一抽象层级；不遗漏核心子主题；分支数 4-8 个为宜；中英文术语对照；图标与节点语义一致。
